pinned_comment: Bate esse tempo aí 😎 Qual seria o seu primeiro split?
notes: F16 visual system designed here (speed streaks + HUD glass, Teko display, Rajdhani labels, JetBrains Mono timer; lime = split done, gold = record). Timer runs in real time (GO at 1.2 s, stops at 9.9 s run time on the alarm). Split names shortened to fit the HUD: 'Liga e desliga o PC' -> 'Desliga o PC'; 'Alarme de shiny no WhatsApp' -> 'Alarme no zap' with a star tile and a '✨ Shiny detectado!' notification (illustrative, labelled 'exemplo'; the optional shiny-cubone print was not used because ASSETS.md was not published yet). Added fine print '*configurar leva mais que 10s. O suporte te ajuda.' so the speedrun joke never reads as a setup-time claim. No deltas vs an invented PB: split times are this run's real timer values. Loop seam: the last 0.4 s rebuilds the frame-0 title + '3'. Known minor issue (render budget used, 3/3): the end-card ask 'Consegue bater esse tempo?' measures x 135–903 at y≈1120–1170, 23 px past the x ≤ 880 rail guide; later shorts cap the ask at 720 px on two lines. Orchestrator edit: end-card ask set to 58 px with max-width 760 px so it ends inside the right-rail line (x <= 880).
